Published in *Global Ecology and Conservation*. [doi:10.1016/j.gecco.2025.e03722](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gecco.2025.e03722)

Ten years of online marketplace records reveal trade trends for land hermit crabs and their implications for conservation management.
